facts.statement: SOE posted Ask-A-Dev Video #4, a video in which a Game Designer and a Lead Character Artist answer player questions about Free Realms.
facts.quote: Watch our latest "Ask-A-Dev" video with Game Designer Margaret Krohn and Lead Character Artist Matt Case as they answer player questions

article_summaries.title: Ask-A-Dev Video #4
article_summaries.summary: This is a short official freerealms.com news post announcing Ask-A-Dev Video #4, in which Game Designer Margaret Krohn and Lead Character Artist Matt Case answer player questions. The post says the video gives clues about what the team has planned for Free Realms, but names no specific content, dates or mechanics. It contains no quest, item, price or number data.
